title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Completed the annual load forecast and reliability review. Imputed missing data, generated a synthetic annual forecast based on the 1-week sample, analyzed reliability metrics (peak load, load factor, load duration curve, ramp rates), and compiled the findings into report/report.md with corresponding figures.
